answer: The wander schedule is applied in mesa and tundra makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2330 identities would post 3310 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
